notes.title: Adventure Discovery Bundle
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

Just to announce you that Yesterday Origins is also available in a special adventure Microïds games bundle named: Adventure Discovery Bundle. 

Inside you have 6 games including the episodes 1 & 2 of the famous Syberia saga: 
- Syberia (82 Metascore)
- Syberia II (80 Metascore)
- Subject 13
- Agatha Christie - The ABC Murders 
- The Descendant - Complete Season (Episodes 1-5)
- Yesterday Origins (74 Metascore)
								
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/bundles/3031/evjh1vys131kcnd2/header_586x192.jpg?t=1493033013

Enjoy!

notes.title: [UPDATE] HUMAN CALCULATOR
notes.content:
Dear friends, 

A new update of the game is available. You'll be finally able to unlock all the achievements. 

What's in the update:

- "Human Calculator" achievement fixed (we hope this time all is right :D)
-  Minor bug fixes

Thanks for playing!
